roots.origin: 拉丁语 lex（属格 legis：成文的法条），动词 legare 表「依法委派、立遗嘱交付」；与 legere（读、拣选）虽形近而不同根，本项目分立两根
roots.core_concept: the written statute that binds all alike / 立成条文、对谁都一样管的法
roots.core_image: 石板上刻好的条文立在广场中央，谁走过都得照着办

roots.origin: 拉丁语 ligare（捆、绑住），ligamentum（韧带）同根；与 lex（法）、legere（读）都不同根，vetted 里同作 leg 是自动提取所致
roots.core_concept: to tie a cord so the two cannot come apart / 用绳把两边系住，再分不开
roots.core_image: 一根绳把两只手腕系在一起，想抽也抽不出来

roots.origin: 拉丁语 proprius（自己的、专属的），由 pro privo（归私有）而来；与 portio（份）一支的 proportion 不同源，vetted 同作 prop 是自动提取所致
roots.core_concept: what belongs to this one and no other / 专属于这一个、别处不作数
roots.core_image: 一件物上刻着自己的名号，别人拿了也对不上

roots.origin: 拉丁语用后缀 -ter/-terior 构成「两者相比」的对照级：exterus（外）→ exterior，interus（内）→ interior，deterior（更差）→ deteriorate。这三词共用的不是某个实义词根，而是这套对照级构词法
roots.core_concept: of two sides compared, the one further that way / 两边一比，更偏那一头的那个
roots.core_image: 两样东西并排一放，指着更偏一头的那个说就是它

roots.origin: 拉丁语 modus（量度、限度、办法），modestus（守分寸的）、modulus（小尺度）同根
roots.core_concept: the measure kept, neither over nor under / 守住的那个量，不多也不少
roots.core_image: 量杯上刻着一道线，倒到那道线就停手

roots.origin: 拉丁语 qualis（何种、什么样的），qualitas（性质）由此出；英语 quality/qualify 均循此路
roots.core_concept: what kind a thing is, and whether it measures up / 是什么成色，够不够格
roots.core_image: 两块料子对着光看纹理，分出哪一块成色更足

concepts.concept: the written statute that binds all alike
concepts.core_image: 广场中央立着刻好条文的石板，谁走过都照它办

concepts.concept: to tie a cord so the two cannot come apart
concepts.core_image: 绳子把两只手腕系在一起，想抽也抽不出来

concepts.concept: what belongs to this one and no other
concepts.core_image: 物件上刻着自己的名号，别人拿了对不上

concepts.concept: of two sides compared, the one further that way
concepts.core_image: 两样东西并排一放，指着更偏一头的那个

concepts.concept: the measure kept, neither over nor under
concepts.core_image: 量杯上一道刻线，倒到那道线就停手

concepts.concept: what kind a thing is, and whether it measures up
concepts.core_image: 两块料子对着光看纹理，分出哪块成色更足

words.root_logic: leg（法条）+ -al（…的）→ 属于成文法的、法条许可的
words.origin: 拉丁语 legalis（属于法的），来自 lex/legis（法条）
words.native_definition: relating to the law; allowed by the law
words.core_concept: standing on the side the statute allows – 站在条文许可的那一边
words.core_image: 翻到条文那一页，指着其中一行说这样办没问题
examples: She sought legal advice at once.
It is legal to park here on Sundays.
semantic_expansions: 法律的：属于成文法条的
合法的：落在条文许可那一边的
words.recall_hint: leg（法条）+ -al → 属于成文法、为条文所许

words.root_logic: de-（往下）+ leg（依法委派）+ -ate → 依法把职权往下交给人 → 委派
words.origin: 拉丁语 delegare（委派、转交），来自 de＋legare（依法交付）← lex
words.native_definition: to give a task or authority to someone else; a person sent to represent others
words.core_concept: handing one's warrant down to another to act on it – 把自己那份凭据往下交给人去行使
words.core_image: 他在名册上点了一个人，把盖印的文书交到那人手里
examples: A good manager knows how to delegate.
Each branch sent two delegates.
semantic_expansions: 委派/授权：依法把职权往下交出
代表：受此委派、代人出面的那个人
words.recall_hint: de-（往下）+ leg（依法委派）→ 把凭据往下交给人

words.root_logic: leg（立遗嘱交付）+ -acy → 依遗嘱交下来的东西 → 遗赠，引申为前人留下的
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 legatia（遗赠），来自 legare（立遗嘱交付）← lex（法）
words.native_definition: money or property left in a will; something handed down from the past
words.core_concept: what a warrant hands on after its holder is gone – 立据人身后依据文书交下来的东西
words.core_image: 老人过世后，铁盒里的文书按写明的那样一件件交到后人手上
examples: He left a small legacy to the school.
The war left a legacy of mistrust.
semantic_expansions: 遗产/遗赠：依文书身后交下来的东西
遗留：前人手里传下来的那一份
words.recall_hint: leg（立遗嘱交付）+ -acy → 依文书交下来的东西

words.root_logic: ob-（朝向）+ lig（绑）+ -ation → 被绑在某事上、不得不做的那份
words.origin: 拉丁语 obligatio（束缚、义务），来自 obligare（绑住）← ob＋ligare
words.native_definition: something one is bound to do, by duty or by law
words.core_concept: the cord tying one to a task one cannot walk away from – 把人系在某事上、走不开的那根绳
words.core_image: 手腕上那圈绳一头系在事上，脚步再急也带着它
examples: He has a legal obligation to pay.
She felt no obligation to reply.
semantic_expansions: 义务/责任：被系在某事上、非做不可的那份
约束：那根绳本身的拉力
words.recall_hint: ob-（朝向）+ lig（绑）→ 被系在某事上走不开

words.root_logic: re-（再、牢）+ lig（绑）+ -ion → 把人反复系向神明的那套联结
words.origin: 拉丁语 religio（虔敬、戒律），一说来自 religare（牢牢系住）← re＋ligare
words.native_definition: belief in and worship of a god or gods, with its practices
words.core_concept: the cord that ties a people back to what they hold sacred – 把人一再系回所敬之物的那根绳
words.core_image: 众人依着同一套誓约聚在一处，绳结般彼此系住
examples: Religion shapes much of the local custom.
She studies comparative religion.
semantic_expansions: 宗教/信仰：把人一再系向所敬之物的那套联结
words.recall_hint: re-（牢）+ lig（绑）→ 把人一再系回所敬之物

words.root_logic: religion（联结）+ -ous（…的）→ 属于那套联结的；引申为一丝不苟
words.origin: 拉丁语 religiosus（虔敬的、谨守的），来自 religio
words.native_definition: relating to religion; believing strongly; done with scrupulous care
words.core_concept: holding to the cord without letting it slack – 攥着那根绳不让它松
words.core_image: 他每日照着同一套仪节做，一次也没落下
examples: He comes from a religious family.
She keeps religious records of every payment.
semantic_expansions: 宗教的：属于那套联结的
虔诚的：攥住绳子不放松
严谨的：同样这份不肯松的劲用在做事上
words.recall_hint: religion（联结）+ -ous → 攥着那根绳不放松

words.root_logic: proprius（专属的）→ 正是这一个该有的样子 → 恰当、合规矩
words.origin: 古法语 propre，来自拉丁语 proprius（自己的、专属的）
words.native_definition: right, suitable, or correct for the situation
words.core_concept: the one form that fits this case and no other – 只有这一种才对得上这场合
words.core_image: 钥匙插进去一转就开，别的哪一把都对不上这个孔
examples: Use the proper tool for the job.
That is not the proper way to ask.
semantic_expansions: 适当的/正确的：正是这场合专该有的那一种
真正的：名实相符、对得上的
words.recall_hint: proprius（专属的）→ 正对得上这场合的那一种

words.root_logic: propr（自己的）+ -ty → 归自己名下之物；也指物本身专有的性状
words.origin: 古法语 propriete，来自拉丁语 proprietas（所有权、特性）← proprius
words.native_definition: a thing owned; land and buildings; a quality belonging to something
words.core_concept: what stands under one's own name, or a trait belonging to a thing alone – 记在自己名下之物，或某物独有的性状
words.core_image: 文书上写明这几间屋归他名下；铁遇火会红，这是铁自带的脾性
examples: All his property passed to his son.
Salt has the property of preserving food.
semantic_expansions: 财产/房产：记在自己名下之物
特性：某物专有、别物没有的性状
words.recall_hint: propr（自己的）+ -ty → 归自己名下之物，及物自带的性状

words.root_logic: exter（外）+ -ior（对照级）→ 两边相比更靠外的那一面
words.origin: 拉丁语 exterior（较外的），exterus（在外的）的比较级
words.native_definition: the outer surface or appearance of something
words.core_concept: the further-out of the two faces – 里外一比，更靠外的那一面
words.core_image: 手掌沿墙抹过去，摸到的是朝着风雨的那一面
examples: The exterior walls need painting.
Beneath his calm exterior he was furious.
semantic_expansions: 外部的/外表：里外相比更靠外的那一面
words.recall_hint: exter（外）+ -ior（对照级）→ 更靠外的那一面

words.root_logic: inter（内）+ -ior（对照级）→ 两边相比更靠里的那一面
words.origin: 拉丁语 interior（较内的），interus（在内的）的比较级
words.native_definition: the inside part of something; the inland part of a country
words.core_concept: the further-in of the two faces – 里外一比，更靠里的那一面
words.core_image: 推门进去，脚步声在四壁之间来回撞
examples: The car has a leather interior.
They travelled into the interior.
semantic_expansions: 内部的/内部：里外相比更靠里的那一面
内地：一国之中更靠里、离海更远的那片
words.recall_hint: inter（内）+ -ior（对照级）→ 更靠里的那一面

words.root_logic: deterior（更差，比较级）+ -ate（使/变）→ 一路往更差那头去
words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 deteriorare（使变坏），来自 deterior（较差的，de- 的比较级）
words.core_concept: sliding step by step toward the worse of the two – 一步步滑向两者中更差那一头
words.core_image: 墙面一年比一年斑驳，去年补的那块今年又鼓起来
examples: Her health deteriorated over the winter.
Relations between them deteriorated fast.
semantic_expansions: 恶化/变坏：一路滑向更差那一头
退化：同一方向上功能一路走低
words.recall_hint: deterior（更差）+ -ate → 往更差那头一路去

words.root_logic: mod（量度）+ -er- + -ate → 守在刻线之内的 → 不过火
words.origin: 拉丁语 moderatus（有节制的），moderare（节制）的过去分词 ← modus
words.native_definition: average in amount or degree; not extreme
words.core_concept: staying inside the line, never brimming over – 停在刻线之内，不满溢出来
words.core_image: 水倒到刻线就收手，杯子没溢也不见底
examples: Take moderate exercise every day.
He holds moderate political views.
semantic_expansions: 适度的/中等的：停在刻线之内、不过量
温和的：主张同样不走极端
words.recall_hint: mod（量度）+ -ate → 守在刻线之内、不过火

words.root_logic: mod（量度）+ -ify（使…）→ 把尺度调一调 → 修改、使缓和
words.origin: 拉丁语 modificare（限定、调整），来自 modus＋facere（做）
words.native_definition: to change something slightly, especially to improve it
words.core_concept: shifting the line a little rather than remaking the vessel – 把那道刻线挪一点，而非另造一只杯
words.core_image: 把刻线往下挪了半分，别处一概没动
examples: They modified the design slightly.
She modified her tone when he objected.
semantic_expansions: 修改/调整：把尺度挪动一点
使缓和：把话或态度的分寸往回收一点
words.recall_hint: mod（量度）+ -ify → 把那道刻线挪一点

words.root_logic: com-（合）+ mod（量度）+ -ity → 合于尺度、便于计量买卖之物
words.origin: 拉丁语 commoditas（便利、合宜），来自 commodus（合尺度的）← com＋modus
words.native_definition: a thing bought and sold, especially a basic good
words.core_concept: goods cut to a common measure so they can be traded – 按公认尺度计量、可拿去交易之物
words.core_image: 秤上一斤一斤过，按同一把尺子记价开单
examples: Coffee is a global commodity.
Water became a scarce commodity.
semantic_expansions: 商品/日用品：按公认尺度计量、可供买卖之物
words.recall_hint: com-（合）+ mod（量度）→ 合于尺度、可计量买卖之物

words.root_logic: qual（何种性质）+ -ity → 是什么成色 → 品质；也指人身上的特质
words.origin: 拉丁语 qualitas（性质、属性），来自 qualis（何种）
words.native_definition: how good something is; a feature someone or something has
words.core_concept: what kind a thing turns out to be when looked at closely – 细看之下，它到底是什么成色
words.core_image: 对着光看那块料，纹理密实，一眼便知与别的不同
examples: The quality of the cloth is excellent.
Patience is her best quality.
semantic_expansions: 质量/品质：细看之下是什么成色
特质：人或物身上那一样别处没有的性质
words.recall_hint: qual（何种性质）+ -ity → 到底是什么成色

words.root_logic: qual（何种性质）+ -ify（使…）→ 使成色够得上 → 具备资格；也指给话加限定
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 qualificare（定其性质），来自 qualis＋facere（做）
words.native_definition: to reach the required standard; to limit a statement
words.core_concept: coming up to the mark that the kind requires – 成色达到那一档所要求的线
words.core_image: 料子送去过筛，够得上那道线的才盖印放行
examples: She qualified as a doctor last year.
He qualified his praise with one caution.
semantic_expansions: 取得资格/合格：成色够上所要求那道线
限定：给话加一道界线，缩住它的适用范围
words.recall_hint: qual（何种性质）+ -ify → 使成色够上那道线

words.root_logic: qualify（使够格）+ -ation → 够格这件事，及作凭据的那纸；也指附加的限定
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 qualificatio，来自 qualificare
words.native_definition: an official record of passing an exam; a skill making one suitable; a limiting remark
words.core_concept: the proof that one came up to the mark, or the limit set on a claim – 够上那道线的凭据，或给话加的那道界
words.core_image: 抽屉里那张盖了印的纸，写明他过了那道线
examples: She has a teaching qualification.
He agreed, with one qualification.
semantic_expansions: 资格/学历：够上那道线的凭据
限定条件：给话加的那道界
words.recall_hint: qualify（使够格）+ -ation → 够格的凭据，或所加的那道界

words.root_logic: pro-（按照）+ portio（份）→ 按份切分后各占的那一份 → 比例
words.origin: 拉丁语 proportio（比例），来自 pro portione（按份而言）；portio（份）与 pars/partis（部分）同源，故归 pars 一族
words.native_definition: a part considered in relation to the whole; the right relation between parts
words.core_concept: how large a share one piece takes of the whole – 一块在整体里占多大的一份
words.core_image: 圆饼切开，每人手里那块占整张多大，一眼比得出来
examples: A large proportion of the class agreed.
The columns are pleasing in proportion.
semantic_expansions: 比例：一份占整体多大
部分：切出来的那一份本身
均衡：各份之间大小相称
words.recall_hint: pro-（按照）+ portio（份）→ 各占整体的那一份
